assertions.assertion: Subclasses DefaultScopeParser (or implements IScopeParser) and overrides ParseScopeValue(ParseScopeContext)
assertions.rationale: ParameterizedScopeParser subclasses DefaultScopeParser and overrides ParseScopeValue(ParseScopeContext scopeContext).

assertions.assertion: Uses scopeContext.SetParsedValues(name, parameter) for the parameterized scope and SetError/SetIgnore for other cases
assertions.rationale: Uses SetParsedValues(transactionScopeName, parts[1]), SetError for missing parameter, SetIgnore for the bare name, and base for others.

assertions.assertion: Registers the parser via AddScopeParser<T>() on the IdentityServer builder
In IProfileService reads context.RequestedResources.ParsedScopes.FirstOrDefault(x => x.ParsedName == "transaction") and uses its ParsedParameter
assertions.rationale: The profile service uses context.RequestedResources.ParsedScopes.FirstOrDefault(x => x.ParsedName == "transaction") and emits transaction.ParsedParameter as a claim.

assertions.assertion: Does NOT define the parameterized value as a static ApiScope name
assertions.rationale: Only the base ApiScope "transaction" is registered; the :abc123 parameter is parsed at request time, not registered as a static scope.
